description: This file defines an internal interface and a class related to the underlying transport mechanism used in Orleans network connections, specifically involving the IDuplexPipe type from System.IO.Pipelines.

classes.name: UnderlyingConnectionTransportFeature
classes.description: Implements the IUnderlyingTransportFeature interface to hold a transport object of type IDuplexPipe used in Orleans network connections.

methods.name: Transport
methods.description: Property to get or set the underlying transport pipe (IDuplexPipe).
